item.title: 一词一讲：service
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “service” 常见的意思是 “服务”。不过，你知道它还有哪些常用含义吗？在网球、排球等体育运动中，“service” 可以表示 “发球” 或 “发球动作”；而在乘坐交通工具时，“service” 可以指代 “（公共交通的）班次”。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起来学习单词 “service” 的四种常见用法。

用法总结

1. service (名词）：（公共交通的）班次、车次

  • Sorry, can you tell me which platform I need for the 9.15 service?
  • You'd better be going, or you will miss the last service home.

2. service（名词）：（车辆、设备的）定期检修，保养

  • OK, so you're bringing your car in for its annual service? Great, I'll look at it now.
  • Could you please book a service for our boiler? It's not heating the water.

3. service（名词）：（在网球等体育运动中）发球

  • She's been practising her service, and now she's one of the best.
  • He has such a brilliant service game, I'm confident that he'll win the tournament.

4. service（名词）：（高速路旁的）服务区，休息站

  • I'm starving. How long until we get to the services?
  • We should stop at the next service. We're getting low on petrol.

item.title: 一词一讲：Post
item.description:
内容简介

古往今来，“post（书信）” 一直都是人类与远方之人沟通的重要方式。单词 “post” 不仅可以指 “书信” 本身，还能表示 “寄送书信” 的动作，甚至还能指提供这一服务的 “邮政系统”。不过，“post” 还有一些含义与 “书信” 可谓相去甚远。看视频，跟主持人 Georgie 一起学习单词 “post” 的四种常见用法。

用法总结：

1. post（动词）：在网络上发布一条帖子或讯息

  • I've drafted a social media post about my recent trip – should I post it?
  • I accidentally posted the picture of my homework on social media, and now I'm a little embarrassed.

2. post（名词）：发布在网络上的一条帖子或讯息

  • Have you seen the new post from Mary? She's been accepted by her dream university!
  • My brother always writes a new post on Friday, but he missed the last one. I wonder what happened.

3. post（名词）：岗位，招聘启事

  • I saw a job post for my dream role. I think I'm going to apply for it.
  • Our company is hiring for a new post. Why don't you try and make an application for it?

4. post（名词）：（直立插在地面上的）柱子，桩子，杆

  • I can't park my car there, there's a post in the way.
  • Watch out! You almost hit the lamp post!

5. post（介词或词缀）：在……之后

  • When the game's finished, I really enjoy watching the players do their post-match interviews.
  • Are you going to the post-work party later? We've booked a karaoke room for everyone who wants to join.

item.title: 一词一讲：tip
item.description:
内容简介

想不想学几个学英语学习的 “tips（小窍门）”？不如就从单词 “tip” 学起吧！除了表示 “指点，建议，窍门” 之外，“tip” 还可以指 “小费”，甚至能作动词，表示 “倾倒” 或 “倒出”。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起学习单词 “tip” 的四个常见用法。

用法总结

1. tip（动词）：预测……有可能成功

  • She's being tipped to win a gold medal this year.
  • Who do you tip to win the tournament this year?

2. tip（名词）：小费

  • Thank you so much, I've left a 20% tip.
  • I'm never going back to that restaurant again. The waiters are so rude, and they dared to ask for a 30% tip!

3. tip（动词）：倾倒，倒出

  • Weigh the flour and then tip it into your mixing bowl.
  • Sorry that I accidentally tipped your bottle.

4. tip（名词）：垃圾场

  • This garage is full of junk. I need to take it all to the tip.
  • Our local tip has a recycling area for glass, paper and plastic.

item.title: 一词一讲：note
item.description:
内容简介

“Please note!（请注意！）” 你可能知道单词 “note” 可以指 “笔记，便条”，但它还有许多其它含义和用法。除了作动词表示 “记下” 之外，“note” 作名词还可以表示 “音符” 和 “纸币”。看视频，主持人 Georgie 为你讲解单词 “note” 的四个常见含义及其用法。

用法总结：

1. note（动词）：注意，留意

  • Make sure to note the unusual wooden features of this house.
  • Cabin crew advise passengers to note the location of the aircraft’s exits.

2. note（动词）：记下，记录下来

  • Thanks for the advice. I'll note that for next time.
  • When interviewing a candidate, it’s useful to note their responses to interview questions.

3. note（名词）音，音符

  • This song is hard to sing. It has a lot of high notes.
  • The composer wrote down each musical note as the melody formed in her head.

4. note（名词）纸币，钞票

  • Sorry, I don't have any small change. Is it OK to pay in notes?
  • My dad collects rare banknotes from different countries.

item.title: 一词一讲：drop
item.description:
内容简介

我们可以 “drop（丢下，掉落）” 一根铅笔或者一块橡皮。不过，你知道人们有时也会 “drop” 一张专辑、一个人，甚至一项活动吗？这是因为单词 “drop” 的含义其实非常丰富。我们可以用它来表示专辑的 “发布”，开车 “捎某人至某处”，以及 “退出” 某项活动。看视频，主持人 Phil 为你讲解单词 “drop” 的四个含义和用法。

用法总结

1. drop（名词）：滴（液体），一点，少许

  • I planted all these seeds, but we haven't had a drop of rain!
  • The soup was so tasty, I gobbled it down to the last drop.

2. drop（动词）：放弃，退出；开除，将...排除在外

  • I'm going to drop playing rugby, I keep getting injured.
  • Have you heard? That football star was just dropped from the starting lineup for having a fight.

3. drop（动词）：（用汽车）捎，带（某人至某地）

  • Jump in. I can drop you at the station.
  • Can you drop me off at the next exit please?

4. drop（动词，常用于口语）：（歌曲、电影、电视剧等）发布，上映

  • Make sure you catch my new song. It drops this Friday.
  • She's so talented. She's been dropping new albums every month this year!

item.title: 一词一讲：pop
item.description:
内容简介

提到单词 “pop”，你是不是首先会想到 “流行乐”？这是因为 “pop” 本身可以是 “popular music” 的缩写。除此之外，这个发音简短有力的单词还可以作拟声词，用来形容 “砰”、“啪” 等声音；它也可以作动词，表示 “爆开”、“引人注意”，甚至在口语中还能简洁地表达 “去（某个地方）” 或 “快速地放”。看视频，跟主持人 Becca 一起学习 “pop” 的四种常见用法。

用法总结

1. pop（拟声词）：发出砰的一声；啪的一声

  • What's that cereal called? The one that pops when you pour the milk in.
  • My baby sister loves the sound of bubbles popping.

2. pop（动词）：爆开，突然释放能量

  • Stop blowing up that balloon, it's going to pop!
  • If I drink any more fizzy soda I feel I might pop!

3. pop（动词）：显眼，特别醒目，引人注意

  • I love wearing bright colours that pop, especially in summer.
  • I read in an article that wearing blue makes brown eyes pop.

4. pop（动词，常用于口语）：去，快速地放

  • I've just popped to the shop. I'll pop the milk in the fridge.
  • She'll be with you in a moment. She's just popped to the toilet.

item.title: 一词一讲：filter
item.description:
内容简介

名词 “filter” 指 “过滤装置”。作动词时，它可以表示 “过滤” 这个动作。不过，除了滤水、滤咖啡、滤化学试剂，你知道它也能用来表示 “过滤，筛选” 信息吗？不仅如此，拍照时用来美化照片的 “滤镜”，也被称为 “filter”。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起学习单词 “filter” 的更多地道用法吧。

用法总结：

1. filter（名词）：滤镜

  • Get rid of that filter. It makes the pictures look ridiculous.
  • Have you tried the new video filter? It can turn your face into a melon!

2. speak with no filter（短语）：口无遮拦，心直口快

  • Just to warn, she always speaks with no filter, so don't be offended.
  • He sometimes speaks with no filter when it gets too busy, but he means no harm.

3. filter（动词）：过滤，筛选（信息）

  • Click to filter it, so you only see the tickets that are still available.
  • Can you filter out all your holidays on this calendar please? We need to find a time when everyone's available.

4. filter（动词）：慢慢传开，透露出来

  • Some details of the management's plans have filtered down to us.
  • The structure of our company needs to be more efficient. It takes too long for any information to filter through to the board.

item.title: 一词一讲：jam
item.description:
内容简介

你爱吃 “jam（果酱）” 吗？那么单词 “jam” 的其它含义可也要记好！除了果酱，名词 “jam” 还可以表示 “最喜欢的歌” 和 “交通堵塞”。如果什么东西被 “塞满了，卡住了，堵住了”，我们还可以用形容词 “jammed” 来描述。看节目，跟主持人 Becca 学习单词 “jam” 的含义和用法。

用法总结

1. jam（名词）：最喜欢的歌

  • I love this song – this is my jam.
  • Have you heard that new song? It's a jam!

2. jam（动词）：即兴演奏，即兴演出

  • I usually jam with my housemate in the evenings. I play guitar and she plays bass.
  • I learned the drums in school, and I would jam during lunch break.

3. (traffic) jam（名词）：交通堵塞

  • Urgh, I'm going to be late. Maybe I should call my boss and tell them I'm stuck in a traffic jam.
  • If this traffic jam doesn't start moving soon, I may have to change my route.

4. jam（动词）：把...完全填满；jammed（形容词）：塞满的，卡住的

  • Oops. I think I jammed too much paper into the printer. It's jammed now!
  • Stop jamming dishes into the dish washer, they won't get properly cleaned.

item.title: 一词一讲：spring
item.description:
内容简介

你可能知道单词 “spring” 是一个名词，意思是 “春天”。不过，你知道它还有 “泉” 和 “弹簧” 的意思，而且还能作动词使用吗？看视频，跟主持人 Georgie 一起学习单词 “spring” 的四个常见含义及其用法。

用法总结

1. spring（动词）：跳，跃，蹦

  • The cat springs onto the platform.
  • When he realised he was late, he sprang out of his chair to get ready.

2. spring（名词）：弹簧

  • This bed is uncomfortable because you can really feel the springs in the mattress.
  • The trampoline has springs to make it bouncy.

3. spring（动词）：源于，产生于

  • Many of their problems spring from a lack of communication.
  • New questions sprang in his mind while reading the updated report.

4. spring（名词）：泉

  • Spring water has lots of minerals, but to drink it, you have to make sure it's safe.
  • My hands were sticky, so I found a spring to wash them in.

item.title: 一词一讲：block
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “block” 不只有 “一块” 这个含义，还可以指一些在形状或给人感觉上像 “一大块” 的事物，比如 “街区” 或 “障碍，阻碍”，甚至 “思维上的瓶颈”。“Block” 还可以作动词，意思是 “堵塞、阻碍”。随着互联网的发展，它又衍生出了 “屏蔽（消息）” 和 “将某人拉入黑名单” 等含义。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起学习单词 “block” 的常见含义和用法。

用法总结：

1. block（名词）：街区，由街道围成的区域

  • We can walk. It's only two blocks away.
  • I live on a quiet block that has some green space and some trees.

2. block（名词）：障碍，阻碍；思维瓶颈

  • I've got writer's block. I don't know what to write.
  • I've hit a block with this painting. I can't quite work out which colour to paint the sky.

3. block（动词）：堵塞，阻碍

  • We can't go that way. The road's blocked!
  • Can you see the screen from your seat? A pillar is blocking my view.

4. block（动词）：屏蔽（消息），拉黑

  • If they keep bothering you, just block them.
  • I accidently blocked my parents on social media. Now they are asking if I'm OK.

item.title: 一词一讲：label
item.description:
内容简介

给商品贴 “label（标签，价签）” 是生产和销售过程中必不可少的一环；不过，给一个人 “label（贴标签、下定论）” 却未必是尊重对方的做法。看视频，跟主持人 Becca 一起学习单词 “label” 还有哪些常见的地道用法。

用法总结

1. label（名词）：标签

  • I always check the labels of food in the supermarket.
  • Can you read the nutrition label on that cereal box? I'd like to know how many calories are in a serving.

2. label（动词）：给…贴标签，对…下定论

  • You shouldn't label people just because of their style. They could wear dark clothes and have a bright personality.
  • He labels himself as a team player, which I don't think he is because he hardly listens to other people's advice.

3. label（名词）：公司，品牌商品

  • My favourite band just signed a contract with a famous record label. I'm so proud of them.
  • They used to be a major record label, but now they only have a handful of musicians.

4. label（名词）：轴标，坐标轴标签

  • The label on the x axis is the number of people shopping with us, and the label on the y axis is time, in months, over this past year.
  • I think we should change the labels on this graph, the current ones are not accurate.
